pageErrors.pageValidationSummaryHeading: There are errors on this page
pageErrors.pageValidationSummaryBody: Fix the following errors before continuing:
pageErrors.reviewPageValidationHeading: Some information is missing or incomplete
pageErrors.reviewPageValidationBody: Review the sections below and fix any errors before submitting your application.
pageErrors.conditionalFieldMissing: Some required information is missing. Review the sections marked with errors.
pageErrors.signatureIncomplete: You must complete both signature steps before submitting your application. Review your certification and authorization.

networkError.heading: We couldn't submit your application
networkError.body: We're sorry. There was a problem submitting your Health Professions Trainee Data Collection Form. Your information has been saved. Please try again in a few minutes. If this problem continues, call us at 1-800-827-1000, Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m. ET.

serverError.heading: We couldn't submit your application
serverError.body: We're sorry. Something went wrong on our end. Your information has been saved. Please try again in a few minutes. If this problem continues, call us at 1-800-827-1000, Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m. ET.

timeout.heading: Your session has timed out
timeout.body: Your session ended because you were inactive for too long. Your progress has been saved. Sign back in to continue your application where you left off.

duplicateSubmission.heading: It looks like you already submitted this form
duplicateSubmission.body: Our records show that a Health Professions Trainee Data Collection Form may have already been submitted from your account. If you believe this is an error, contact your VA training facility's education coordinator.

authenticationRequired.heading: You need to sign in to continue
authenticationRequired.body: You must be signed in with a Login.gov account to complete and submit this form. Sign in or create an account to continue. Your progress will be saved.

saveError.heading: We couldn't save your progress
saveError.body: We're sorry. We couldn't save your application at this time. Try saving again in a few minutes. If this problem continues, you can still complete and submit your application without saving, but you'll need to finish in one session.

loadError.heading: We couldn't load your saved application
loadError.body: We're sorry. We couldn't load your saved application. You can start a new application or try again. If you start a new application, your previous progress will not be available.

expiredSession.heading: Your saved application has expired
expiredSession.body: Saved applications expire after 60 days of inactivity. Your saved progress is no longer available. Please start a new application.

licenseExpiredWarning.heading: This license may be expired
licenseExpiredWarning.body: The expiration date you entered is in the past. If this license is still active, verify the expiration date and re-enter it. If the license is expired, consider whether it belongs in the Prior Licenses section instead. You can still continue — the Designated Education Officer will review your license information.

adverseHistoryYesWarning.heading: Explanation required
adverseHistoryYesWarning.body: Because you answered 'Yes,' you must provide a detailed written explanation on the next page. Your explanation will be reviewed by the VA Designated Education Officer. You cannot submit this form without the required explanation.

fraudHistoryYesWarning.heading: Explanation required
fraudHistoryYesWarning.body: Because you answered 'Yes,' you must provide a detailed written explanation on the next page. Your response will be carefully reviewed as part of the appointment determination process. You cannot submit this form without the required explanation.

malpracticeHistoryYesWarning.heading: Explanation required
malpracticeHistoryYesWarning.body: Because you answered 'Yes,' you must provide a detailed written explanation on the next page. Per the form, your explanation must include the name of the action or proceedings, the date filed, the court or reviewing agency, the status or outcome, and your account of what occurred. You cannot submit this form without the required explanation.

ecfmgRequiredInfo.heading: ECFMG certificate information required
ecfmgRequiredInfo.body: Your ECFMG certificate number and date are required. Missing ECFMG information is a common reason applications from international medical school graduates are returned incomplete.

citizenshipDataCleared.heading: Your visa information has been cleared
citizenshipDataCleared.body: Because you changed your citizenship status, your previously entered visa and immigration information has been removed. If this was a mistake, you can go back and change your citizenship status.

falseStatementsWarning.heading: Federal law — false statements
falseStatementsWarning.body: A false statement on any part of your application may be grounds for not hiring you, or for terminating you after you begin work. Also, you may be punished by fine or imprisonment (U.S. Code, Title 18, Section 1001).

success.heading: Application submitted
success.body: Your Health Professions Trainee Data Collection Form (VA Form 10-2850D) has been submitted successfully.

nextSteps: The Designated Education Officer (DEO) at your VA training facility will review your application and verify your qualifications against the Trainee Qualifications and Credentials Verification Letter (TQCVL).
The Medical Center Director at your training facility must approve your appointment before you can begin training.
Your facility's education office will contact you about your appointment status. If you have questions, contact your VA training facility's education coordinator directly.
confirmationMessages.printPrompt: Print or save this page for your records.
